assignmentBaseline.preExistingChanges: None: clean staged, unstaged and untracked state in the assigned two-file package.

versions.rationale: One patch bump for justified procedural/documentation changes; no subsequent increments.

changes.change: Trace the affected caller through effective DataSource selection to the physical pool/database target and preserve source/capture identity.
changes.consequence: Avoid treating a healthy capture for another pool, tenant database or replica as evidence about the affected request.

changes.change: Distinguish normalized statement identity from individual execution/parameter/plan identity; retain PostgreSQL 18 database/user/query/top-level scope and capture target.
changes.consequence: Avoid invalid joins and unsupported cross-target comparisons from matching SQL or queryid alone.

changes.location: SKILL.md Evidence discipline and Definition of done
changes.change: Revoke only the conclusions whose supporting capture is shown to belong elsewhere; retain supported findings and revise routing/next checks.
changes.consequence: Avoid both stale diagnoses and unjustified reversal to a new fault claim when evidence becomes irrelevant.
Publish the content change with a new immutable version.

preserved: Router role, early stop once one established question has an owner and bounded next check, and supported no-change outcomes.
Optional/proportional evidence packet and authorized incident-mitigation priority.
Capture censoring, timing boundaries, source-versus-materialization distinctions, and counter resets.
Active versus last SQL, pool occupancy versus completed usage, unsafe EXPLAIN replay, and Java/driver/version inspection.
All existing specialist routes, engine-specific caveats and dependencies; no Java baseline or dependency upgrade.
